author: Ztratos
body: Hey, I'm Ztratos, I'm 14 years old, I live in Buenos Aires, Argentina and I satarted to played Avicus some time ago, I'm not very active in the server but I like it very much, I love the PvP and I am in the Clan Banzai Monkeys, so if you have any questions and advices for the forums and the server go ahead, tell me :D
